source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 716 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-716.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 716 was established by Ordinance No. 25877, passed by the Dallas City Council on February 9, 2005. (Ord. 25877)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-716.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 716 is established on property generally located at the intersection of Imperial Street and Bertrand Avenue. The size of PD 716 is approximately 2.02 acres. (Ord. Nos. 25877; 29316)

sections.title: Creation Of Tracts
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-716.103. CREATION OF TRACTS.

This district is divided into Tracts I, II, and III as shown on the development plan (Exhibit 716A). (Ord. 25877)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-716.104. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a residential zoning district. (Ord. 25877)

SEC. 51P-716.104.1. EXHIBIT.

The following exhibit is incorporated into this article: Exhibit 716A: development plan. (Ord. 29316)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-716.105. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

(a) For a community service center or church use, development and use of the Property must comply with the development plan. In the event of a conflict between the text of this article and the development plan, the text of this article controls.

(b) For all other uses, no development plan is required, and the provisions of Section 51A- 4.702 regarding submission of or amendments to a development plan, site analysis plan, conceptual plan, development schedule, and landscape plan do not apply. (Ord. 25877)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-716.106. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

The only main uses permitted are as follows:

(1) Those main uses permitted in the R-5(A) Single Family District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the R-5(A) Single Family District, as set out in the Dallas Development Code. For example, a use permitted in the R-5(A) Single Family District only by specific use permit
(SUP) is permitted in this district only by SUP, and a use subject to development impact review (DIR) in the R-5(A) Single Family District is subject to DIR in this district, etc.

(2) Community service center (permitted by right).

(3) Church (permitted by right).

(4) Surface parking for a community service center or church use (permitted by right). (Ord. 25877)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-716.107. ACCESSORY USES.

As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific types of accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A- 4.217. (Ord. 25877)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-716.108. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Division 51A-4.400. In the event of a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, the yard, lot, and space regulations in Section 51A-4.112(g), "R-5(A) District," apply.

(b) Height.

(1) For nonresidential uses other than a community service center or church, maximum structure height is 54 feet. Nonresidential uses other than a community service center or church are subject to residential proximity slope regulations.

(2) For residential uses, maximum structure height is 30 feet.

(c) Community service center or church use.

(1) Front yard. Minimum front yard is as shown on the development plan.

(2) Side and rear yard. Minimum side and rear yards are as shown on the development plan.

(3) Density. No maximum dwelling unit density.

(4) Floor area. Maximum floor area is 46,000 square feet.

(5) Floor area ratio.

(A) Maximum floor area ratio is 0.5.

(B) For purposes of floor area ratio, the entire district is considered a single lot.

(6) Height. Maximum structure height is 45 feet.

(7) Lot coverage.

(A) Maximum lot coverage is 60 percent.

(B) For purposes of lot coverage, the entire district is considered a single lot.

(C) Aboveground parking structures are included in lot coverage calculations; surface parking lots and underground parking structures are not. (Ord. 25877)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-716.109. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

(a) Consult the use regulations in Division 51A-4.200 for the specific off-street parking/loading requirements for each use.

(b) For a community service center or church use, off-street parking must be provided as shown on the development plan.

(c) For purposes of off-street parking for a community service center or church use, the entire district is considered a single lot. (Ord. 25877)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-716.110. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. 25877)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-716.111. LANDSCAPING.

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, landscaping must be provided in accordance with Article X.

(b) Maintenance. All plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition.

(c) Community service center or church use.

(1) Screening of off-street parking must be provided as shown on the development plan.

(2) At least one of the design standards in Section 51A-10.126 must be provided.

(3) A landscape buffer must be provided as shown on the development plan.

(4) A six-foot-high solid fence is permitted in the front yard in the location shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 25877; 29316)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-716.112. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts in Article VII. (Ord. 25877)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-716.113. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The entire Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 25877)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-716.114. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit to authorize work, or a certificate of occupancy to authorize the operation of a use, in this district until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 25877)
